blocks.text: Đến giờ bạn nói về hiện tại: I am at home. Giờ bạn sẽ học kể về quá khứ: «hôm qua tôi ở nhà», «Giáng sinh chúng tôi ở cùng nhau», «trong túi có hai cái kẹp». Tiếng Anh đổi từ nối sang dạng quá khứ.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua tôi ở nhà.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: Giáng sinh chúng tôi ở cùng nhau.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Trong túi có hai cái kẹp phơi đồ.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Mùa xuân có ấm không?

blocks.text: Tiếng Việt chỉ thêm «hôm qua», động từ không đổi. Tiếng Anh thì phải đổi: am và is thành was, are thành were. I was, she was — you were, we were, they were. Không nói Yesterday I am.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua tôi ở nhà.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Năm ngoái cô ấy ở London.

examples.en: We were at home last night.
examples.translation: Tối qua chúng tôi ở nhà.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: Dịp năm mới họ ở London.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua thợ làm tóc bận.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

drill.why: Với we ở quá khứ là were.

sections.title: Dấu hiệu quá khứ: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Thường trong câu có từ chỉ quá khứ: yesterday — «hôm qua», last night — «tối qua», last year — «năm ngoái». Ngày lễ dùng at: at Christmas, at New Year. Thứ trong tuần dùng on: on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
examples.translation: Chủ nhật tôi ở nhà.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: Giáng sinh chúng tôi ở cùng nhau.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: Dịp năm mới họ ở London.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua trung tâm thể thao đóng cửa.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

fixes.wrong: We were together in Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

sections.title: Hôm qua — was, bây giờ — is

blocks.text: Nói về hôm qua — was hoặc were. Nói về bây giờ — is hoặc are, như trước. Từ yesterday hay now gợi ý ngay: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: Hôm qua khăn tắm biển của tôi bị ướt.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
examples.translation: Hôm qua dép tông của tôi bị bẩn.

examples.en: The shower curtain is dry now.
examples.translation: Rèm tắm bây giờ khô rồi.

examples.en: The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua gương phòng tắm bị bẩn.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Hôm qua khăn tắm bị ướt. Bạn nói thế nào?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
drill.explain: Hôm qua là quá khứ, nên dùng was.

blocks.text: Giống bài 4, thứ không đếm từng cái — kem, đồ ăn, nước ép — đi với dạng số ít: was, không phải were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Hôm qua kem chống nắng ở trong túi tôi.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua nước táo lạnh.

examples.en: The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: Hôm qua sô-cô-la nóng ngọt quá.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: «Không» đặt ngay sau was hoặc were: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Không nói It not was.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: Hôm đó không phải ngày nghỉ của tôi.

examples.en: The fried egg was not cold.
examples.translation: Trứng ốp la không bị nguội.

examples.en: The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: Bơ đậu phộng không ở trên bàn.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Tiếng Việt hỏi «có … không?» và giữ trật tự. Tiếng Anh đưa was hay were lên đầu: Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Trả lời ngắn cũng bằng từ nối: Yes, it was. Không dùng did.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Mùa xuân có ấm không?

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: Mùa thu bạn có ở nhà không?

examples.en: Was your pancake hot?
examples.translation: Bánh kếp của bạn có nóng không?

examples.en: Were the scrambled eggs hot?
examples.translation: Trứng bác có nóng không?

examples.en: Yes, it was.
examples.translation: Có.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

drill.prompt: Hãy hỏi: «Mùa xuân có ấm không?»

sections.title: «Có» trong quá khứ: there was, there were

blocks.text: Tiếng Việt nói «trong túi có hai cái kẹp» cho cả hiện tại lẫn quá khứ. Tiếng Anh đổi: There was cho một vật, There were cho nhiều vật. Không dùng have.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
examples.translation: Trên giường có một tấm ga.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Trong túi có hai cái kẹp phơi đồ.

examples.en: There was a public toilet near the station.
examples.translation: Gần ga có nhà vệ sinh công cộng.

examples.en: There were two taxi drivers near the station.
examples.translation: Gần ga có hai tài xế taxi.

examples.en: There was fruit salad in the bowl.
examples.translation: Trong bát có sa-lát trái cây.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday have two pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

drill.after: two duvet covers in the cupboard.
drill.why: Có hai cái vỏ chăn, nên There were.

blocks.text: Với was dễ nhận xét chuyện đã qua: That was a silly idea — «đó là một ý ngớ ngẩn», The plan was sensible — «kế hoạch hợp lý». Nhiều thứ — were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
examples.translation: Đó là một ý ngớ ngẩn.

examples.en: The plan was sensible.
examples.translation: Kế hoạch đó hợp lý.

examples.en: The rules were fair.
examples.translation: Luật lệ công bằng.

sections.title: Những lỗi gần như ai cũng mắc

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday have two pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Ngữ pháp mới của bài chỉ có hai dạng: was cho I, he, she, it và một vật; were cho you, we, they và nhiều vật. Phần còn lại giống am, is, are.

sections.title: Mang gì vào phần luyện tập

blocks.text: Đã ở, đã là — was hoặc were. Không — was not, were not. Hỏi — Was…? Were…?, trả lời — Yes, it was. Đã có — There was / There were. Hôm qua — was, bây giờ — is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Năm ngoái cô ấy ở London.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: Hôm đó không phải ngày nghỉ của tôi.

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: Mùa thu bạn có ở nhà không?

examples.en: There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
examples.translation: Cạnh bồn rửa có một cái đĩa xà phòng.
